description: THE ORGANIZER'S OWN CHANGE TO THEIR EVENT. Call it when the organizer of an event wants to change its agenda: move a session to a new time or room, rename it, cancel it, or add a session ("move the Women Founders Track to the Harbor Room"). FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm`: the reply is a PREVIEW with a `changeId`, the before and after of each field, how many pass holders would be notified and the exact notice, and nothing changes. Read that preview back to the organizer and ask; only when they say yes, call again with `confirm: true` and that `changeId`. Name the session by the `sessionId` the agenda gave or by its title; if the reply says AMBIGUOUS or NO_SUCH_SESSION, read the candidates back and ask which one. Never invent a sessionId. Only the organizer of the event can change it; anybody else is refused, and you read the refusal out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

at.description: OPTIONAL. The session's current start ("10:30 AM"), to tell apart sessions with the same title.

changeId.description: REQUIRED with confirm: the changeId the preview returned.

confirm.description: Leave out for the PREVIEW. Only after the organizer says yes to the preview, call again with confirm: true and the changeId.

date.description: OPTIONAL. The day, YYYY-MM-DD, when the event runs more than one day or the session moves to another day.

end.description: The new end, same forms. Left out on move_time, the session keeps its length.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event name as the organizer spells it.

kind.description: REQUIRED for a preview. move_time (pass `start`, optionally `end` and `date`), move_room (pass `room`), rename (pass `title`), cancel, add_session (pass `title`, `start`, `end`, `room`, optionally `date` and `speakers`).

notify.description: OPTIONAL. A time or room move notifies pass holders by default; cancel, rename and add are quiet unless this is true. False keeps any change quiet.

room.description: The room or place label, plain words.

sessionId.description: The session's id exactly as the agenda or a candidates list gave it. Never made up.

sessionTitle.description: Or the session's title as the agenda spells it, when there is no sessionId.

speakers.description: OPTIONAL, for add_session: speaker names; a name that matches the event's speakers is linked, any other is kept as a plain name.

start.description: The new start: "4:30 PM", or a full timestamp with a time zone. Read in the event's own time zone.

title.description: The new or added session's title.

name: event_change
title: Change an event's agenda (organizers only)
